scope: Exact-snapshot focused review of section 2.4 ExecutePinnedCleanup branch clarification.
checks: Existing durable present witness: revalidate immutable anchor/source/principal binding; same present identity continues the original unlink; precise ENOENT reuses the original witness for recovery; other states fail indeterminate.
No witness: locked no-follow observation must match the expected anchored present identity; first absence or unknown cannot produce a success receipt or completed CAS.
New initial witness becomes durable only after executing-owner and anchor CAS verification, before unlink. Receipt and terminal CAS must both be durable before success acknowledgement.
The clarification preserves resource-lock, principal isolation and immutable evidence constraints and does not grant a new operation or cross-run retry.
limits: Source hash verified. No tests or implementation changes. PASS is limited to this design clarification and carries forward review2 scope; no native VFS/security or classroom readiness acceptance.
